en: <t1>Credential material never reaches the disk.</t1> People paste keys into prompts, and a record is the one file here whose content nobody vetted before it was written. The known credential shapes — provider API keys, GitHub tokens, AWS key ids, Slack and Stripe tokens, PEM headers, bearer tokens, and an assignment of a long opaque value to something called a key, a token or a password — are replaced on the way to the record, before the bytes are anywhere but a variable. Nothing downstream sees the original: not the record, not either rendering, not the file name, not the log, which prints a payload's key names and never a value. What was replaced is recorded in <t2/>, so "nothing was found" and "the secret is gone" are statements a reader can tell apart.
cs: <t1>Přihlašovací údaje se nikdy nedostanou na disk.</t1> Lidé vkládají klíče do promptů a záznam je jediný soubor, jehož obsah nikdo před zápisem neprověřil. Známé tvary přihlašovacích údajů — API klíče providerů, tokeny GitHubu, id klíčů AWS, tokeny Slacku a Stripe, hlavičky PEM, bearer tokeny a přiřazení dlouhé neprůhledné hodnoty něčemu, co se jmenuje klíč, token nebo heslo — se nahrazují cestou do záznamu, dříve než bajty jsou kdekoli jinde než v proměnné. Nic dále po proudu originál nevidí: ani záznam, ani jedno z vykreslení, ani název souboru, ani log, který vypisuje názvy klíčů payloadu a nikdy hodnotu. Co bylo nahrazeno, je zaznamenáno v <t2/>, takže „nic nebylo nalezeno“ a „tajemství je pryč“ jsou tvrzení, která čtenář dokáže rozlišit.

en: The provider channel is unbounded (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/manager.rs:<n1/> channel()) and feeds one thread that runs an Ed25519 verify per datagram, with no per-source rate and no drop counter (threat T3). Rendezvous and link replies to the dialer are read with an unbounded read_to_end (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mcp/bridge.rs:84-85) under a per-read timeout only, so a slow trickle holds the worker and the per-runtime round lock (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:2383-2387) (T4), and the candidate count received is unbounded. docs/MESH.md:<n2/> lists 'messages (<n3/> KiB)' as a flood bound, which holds only for what the answerer receives (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:1769-1779, 2010-2020) and the dialer sends (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/link.rs:883-888). mesh.register answers its own envelope and up to <n4/> candidates even when the caller's envelope is refused (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/manager.rs:623-636), and the candidates include untrusted nodes of any repository (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/registry.rs:342-357) (T2, T13). An UnknownLink answer is retried with zero delay (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:2592-2595), so a peer that welcomes and then refuses sync drives a busy loop, and the link backoff has no jitter (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:2611-2614). Baseline audit of 2026-10-09 at master 1fb8d6be44, mesh gaps <n5/> and <n6/>, threats T2, T3, T4 and T13, drift <n7/>.
cs: Kanál poskytovatele je neomezený (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/manager.rs:<n1/> channel()) a krmí jedno vlákno, které provádí Ed25519 verify na každý datagram, bez limitu na zdroj a bez počítadla zahozených (hrozba T3).
